title: Palmonas Demi-Fine Jewellery — Plating Life, Care & Warranty (2026)
description: What Palmonas actually says about its materials, lab-grown stones and lifetime warranty — plus a plating-life comparison so you know what '18k plated' really means.

forWho: Indian shoppers comparing plated, vermeil and solid-gold jewellery on expected plating life rather than on the word 'gold' alone.
Buyers who want to know exactly what the Palmonas lifetime warranty covers before buying a daily-wear chain, stud or ring.
skipIf: Anyone who expects plated jewellery to behave like solid gold in a pool, gym or monsoon — no amount of care makes a plating permanent.
Buyers wanting an independently verified stone certificate for a specific SKU; we did not open one.

content_blocks.heading: How long does Palmonas plating last, and is a lab-grown diamond a real diamond?
content_blocks.body: Palmonas says its Demifine pieces use 925 sterling silver or surgical-grade stainless steel finished with rhodium, 18k gold vermeil or 18k gold-tone plating, and that plated pieces should last 'years' with care. It does not publish a fixed life in months, so treat any 2–4 year promise elsewhere as unverified. Its official lifetime warranty covers plating tarnish or discolouration on 0–6 months with replacement, then declining wallet credit. Independent references confirm lab-grown diamonds are real diamonds by composition; we did not verify a certificate for any specific piece.

items.title: What 'Demifine' means on the official site
items.body: Palmonas describes Demifine as sitting between fine and fashion jewellery: 925 sterling silver or surgical-grade stainless steel, finished with rhodium, 18k gold vermeil or 18k gold-tone plating, with cubic zirconia, pearls and lab-grown diamonds used for sparkle. The brand says no nickel or brass and calls the pieces hypoallergenic, anti-tarnish and sweatproof. Those are brand claims recorded here, not independent lab results.

items.title: Plating life: what 'years' actually means
items.body: The official FAQ's answer to 'How long does gold plated jewellery actually last?' is 'With proper care? Years' — it does not give a month count. That is why the 2–4 year figure in older Durza copy is not repeated. A useful independent anchor: the US definition of vermeil requires sterling silver plated with at least 10-karat gold to a minimum thickness of about 2.5 microns, and even silver-gilt pieces historically needed regilding after a few years of regular handling. Plating wears; the question is how gracefully, and what the warranty does when it does.

items.title: The warranty is the real value signal
items.body: The official Lifetime Warranty Policy covers tarnishing or discolouration of plating on eligible Demifine pieces. Resolution: replacement in 0–6 months, 50% of invoice value in Palmonas Wallet at 6–9 months, 25% at 9–12 months, and 15% beyond 12 months. Exclusions include regular wear and tear, mishandling, lost stones or crystals, third-party alterations and custom-made sets. Wallet credit is not refundable or transferable. Read that before treating 'lifetime' as 'new forever'.

items.title: Lab-grown diamonds — be precise about the claim
items.body: The brand FAQ says a lab-grown diamond has the same physical, optical and chemical properties as a mined diamond, while answering 'Is lab grown diamond real?' with the confusing phrase 'Not really!'. Independent reference material resolves it: gem-quality lab-grown diamonds are chemically and physically diamond, and major labs laser-inscribe lab-grown reports on the girdle. So ask the seller for the exact stone type on each product page — the site says it discloses cubic zirconia versus lab-grown per design — and do not assume every sparkly piece is a diamond.

items.title: Care that actually helps in Indian conditions
items.body: The brand's own guidance: keep pieces away from strong chemicals, clean gently with a soft cloth and store dry; it also suggests removing them before showers, workouts and contact with harsh soaps or perfumes. In practice, sweat, monsoon humidity, chlorine and sunscreen are the usual culprits. Put jewellery on last and take it off first, wipe it dry after a long day, and store it separately so chains do not abrade each other.

items.body: Decide the finish first: vermeil over sterling silver, gold-tone plating, or rhodium. The finish decides how the piece ages, not the word 'gold' in the product name.
On 26 Nov 2026 the homepage displayed B1G1 with code B1G1 and a 'Buy 4 At ₹2999 + 2 more' promotion on selected bestsellers. Check whether they combine in your cart — do not assume stacking.
For a first order, a single chain or pair of studs in a finish you can test against your routine is more useful than a full matching set.
Read the exact product page for stone type — the site says it discloses cubic zirconia versus lab-grown diamond per design.
Save the invoice. The warranty's replacement and wallet-credit slabs depend on proof of purchase and inspection.
Keep the care guide and store the piece dry and separate. Warranty excludes regular wear and tear, so good storage is the part you control.

items.label: Demifine uses silver or steel plus plating, not solid gold.
items.value: The official site says pieces are made with 925 sterling silver or surgical-grade stainless steel and finished with rhodium, 18k gold vermeil and 18k gold-tone plating. It also says no nickel or brass is used.

items.label: The brand gives no fixed plating life.
items.value: Its FAQ says gold-plated jewellery lasts 'years' with proper care and thicker-than-average plating; it does not publish a month or year count. The 2–4 year figure in older Durza copy is therefore unverified.

items.label: The lifetime warranty has a declining credit schedule.
items.value: Official policy: plating tarnish/discolouration is covered; replacement at 0–6 months, 50% wallet credit at 6–9 months, 25% at 9–12 months and 15% beyond 12 months. Regular wear, mishandling and lost stones are excluded.

items.label: Vermeil has a defined minimum plating in the US standard.
items.value: Under 16 CFR Part 23.4 as summarised in the reference, vermeil requires a sterling-silver base coated with at least 10-karat gold to a minimum thickness of about 2.5 microns. Palmonas uses the word 'vermeil', but we did not verify the plated thickness of any specific piece.

items.label: Lab-grown diamonds are real diamonds by composition.
items.value: Independent reference: synthetic/lab-grown diamond is pure carbon with the same chemical and physical properties as mined diamond, and major labs laser-inscribe lab-grown reports on the girdle. Ask for the exact stone type on the product page; we did not open a certificate.

content_blocks.text: We checked Palmonas' official homepage/FAQ and its Lifetime Warranty Policy, and read independent reference material on vermeil and lab-grown diamonds, on 26 Nov 2026. No purchase, wear test, plating-thickness measurement or stone-certificate check was performed. Prices and promotions are dated snapshots; the 2–4 year plating figure and any certification claim from older Durza copy are explicitly unverified. Durza earns a commission on qualifying purchases through tracked links at no extra cost to you.

items: 'Waterproof' and 'sweatproof' are marketing claims. Chlorine, salt water, perfume and sunscreen still shorten the life of a plated finish.
Vermeil and gold-tone plating are different finishes; the product page, not the collection name, tells you which one you are buying.
The lifetime warranty pays declining wallet credit after six months, not a replacement forever — and the wallet credit is not refundable.
Cubic zirconia is a simulant, not a diamond. The site says it discloses which is used per design; confirm on the exact SKU.
Silver-gilt history shows even thick plating can need regilding with frequent handling. Plan for eventual maintenance rather than assuming permanence.

items.q: How long does Palmonas 18k plating last?
items.a: The official FAQ says 'years' with proper care but gives no fixed figure. We did not verify the 2–4 year claim from older Durza copy. What is published and checkable is the warranty schedule: replacement in the first six months, then 50%, 25% and 15% wallet credit by time band, with wear and tear excluded.

items.q: Are Palmonas lab-grown diamonds real diamonds?
items.a: By composition, yes: independent references describe lab-grown diamond as the same carbon crystal with the same chemical and physical properties as mined diamond, and major labs mark lab-grown reports on the girdle. The Palmonas FAQ's 'Not really!' answer is confusingly worded. Ask for the stone type on the exact product page — some pieces use cubic zirconia instead.

items.q: Can I wear Palmonas in a pool or the sea?
items.a: The brand calls its pieces waterproof but still advises removing them before showers and workouts. Chlorine and salt are harsher than a splash of water. For a plated finish, the safe rule is: no pool, no sea, no gym, and wipe dry after a sweaty day.

items.q: Will Palmonas turn my skin green?
items.a: The brand says it uses no nickel or brass and that pieces are hypoallergenic, based on 925 sterling silver or surgical-grade stainless steel. We did not wear-test any piece, so this is a published claim rather than a Durza finding. If you react to plated jewellery, patch-test a single piece before committing to a set.

items.q: Did Durza test the plating or stones?
items.a: No. We read published pages on 26 Nov 2026, bought nothing, measured no plating and opened no certificate. All material and performance statements are attributed to the brand or to the cited references.
